plan.title: Explore dataset structure and statistics
plan.description: Write scratch.py to load annotations.json and metadata.json. Print: number of images, annotations, categories, annotation distribution per image (min/max/mean/median), category frequency distribution, how many categories have <5 annotations, image sizes, and verify file paths exist for a sample of train images and product reference images. Also check which product_codes in annotations have matching folders in data/products/.
plan.success_criteria: Complete statistical summary of the dataset logged, understanding of class distribution and data linkage

plan.title: Single-class YOLOv8m detection baseline at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: A single-class YOLOv8m detector at 1280px trained for 50 epochs will achieve detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.60, giving final_score > 0.42 (with classification=0)
plan.description: Fix the environment by ensuring ultralytics is properly imported. Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format with ALL categories mapped to class 0 (single-class detection). Split 80/20 train/val. Train YOLOv8m at imgsz=1280 for 50 epochs with batch=8. Evaluate detection mAP@0.5 on val set using pycocotools. This establishes a working baseline and validates the full pipeline. Key changes to main.py: simplify to single-class, use YOLOv8m (not l), reduce epochs to 50 for faster iteration.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes, detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.50, pipeline produces valid predictions

plan.title: Multi-class YOLOv8m detection at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Training with all 356 categories enables both detection and classification scoring, achieving final_score > 0.50 (0.7*det + 0.3*cls)
plan.description: Modify the baseline to train with all 356 categories instead of single-class. Use YOLOv8m at 1280px for 80 epochs. The YOLO model will learn both localization and classification jointly. Evaluate both detection mAP@0.5 (category-agnostic) and classification mAP@0.5 (category-aware). Compare final_score against single-class baseline.

plan.title: Scale up to YOLOv8l with augmentation tuning
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l with copy-paste augmentation and tuned hyperparameters improves both detection and classification over YOLOv8m
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l at 1280px for 100 epochs with batch=4. Enable copy-paste=0.3, mosaic=1.0, mixup=0.1. Use cosine LR schedule. Compare against YOLOv8m results. If detection improves but classification is still weak, this motivates a two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: final_score improvement of at least 0.03 over step 3

plan.title: Fix dependencies and get working YOLOv8m multi-class baseline
plan.hypothesis: Installing pycocotools via subprocess at runtime and using YOLOv8m with 50 epochs will produce a working baseline with final_score > 0.30
plan.description: Add `subprocess.run(['pip', 'install', 'pycocotools'])` at the top of main.py before importing it. Alternatively, restructure to use ultralytics built-in val() metrics and only use pycocotools for final evaluation. Use YOLOv8m (not l) with batch=6, 50 epochs, imgsz=1280, basic augmentations. Focus on getting ANY working result first. Keep the multi-class setup with all 356 categories.
plan.success_criteria: Script runs to completion without import errors. Produces detection_mAP@0.5 and classification_mAP@0.5 metrics. Any non-zero final_score.

plan.title: Tune training: longer epochs, YOLOv8l, enhanced augmentations
plan.hypothesis: Scaling to YOLOv8l with 80-100 epochs, copy-paste augmentation, and cosine LR will improve final_score by 0.05-0.15 over baseline
plan.description: Based on baseline results, upgrade to YOLOv8l, increase epochs to 80-100, add copy-paste=0.3, mosaic=1.0, mixup=0.1, cosine LR with AdamW. Reduce batch size to 4 for memory. Compare against baseline.
plan.success_criteria: final_score improves by at least 0.05 over step 5 baseline

plan.title: Two-stage: YOLO detection + embedding-based crop classification
plan.hypothesis: Using detected crops matched against product reference images via embeddings will boost classification mAP for rare classes by 0.05+
plan.description: Take best detector, run inference to get crops. Extract embeddings using torchvision ResNet50 (pretrained). Compare each crop embedding against reference images (data/products/*/main.jpg) using cosine similarity. Re-assign category based on nearest neighbor. Evaluate classification mAP improvement.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP@0.5 improves by at least 0.03 over pure YOLO classification

plan.title: SAHI tiled inference + ensemble optimization
plan.hypothesis: Sliced inference on high-res images improves small object detection, and combining with full-image predictions via NMS/WBF maximizes final_score
plan.description: Implement SAHI-style tiled inference (640x640 tiles with overlap on original resolution images). Merge tile predictions with full-image predictions using WBF. Tune confidence thresholds. Combine with best classification method. Generate final optimized submission.
plan.success_criteria: final_score improves by at least 0.02 over previous best
